result.title: Fast Bayesian Optimization Through Linear Models
result.summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is typically used only for problems where the underlying function is deemed "expensive" (e.g. in time or money), with the speed of the BO algorithm being of little importance. In the real world, however, problems span a continuous range of values, going from cheap to expensive. In this paper, we present BO algorithms through the lens of a speed-performance Pareto frontier: we compare BO against faster algorithms like CMA-ES, and highlight how certain regions of the Pareto frontier are currently empty. As a solution, we propose a new set of fast BO methods that exploit the linear structure in existing BO algorithms, for both continuous and combinatorial inputs (from ~10 to 6000+ dimensions). Our methods achieve performance similar to state-of-the-art BO, while being more than $10^2\times$ to $10^3\times$ faster, opening the field of BO to an entirely new class of problems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以「速度—性能帕累托前沿」视角审视贝叶斯优化，指出快而好的区间仍然空缺，并提出利用现有 BO 算法中线性结构的高效方法，在连续与组合输入（约 10 至 6000+ 维）上取得接近 SOTA 的性能且快 10^2–10^3 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式的计算成本—性能前沿框架与线性结构加速，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算预算分配及廉价近似状态更新提供类比线索，可迁移性仍需核查。
